summary: Franklin BSP Real Estate Debt, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that on September 14, 2026 it paid August distributions to holders of record as of August 31, 2026 across five share classes. Gross distribution was $0.1900 per share for Class G, G-D, G-S, E and I common stock; servicing fees cut net G-D to $0.1854 and G-S to $0.1737, with Class G, E and I paid at the full $0.1900. Payment was cash or DRIP reinvestment. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed; this is an ordinary REIT distribution notice with no risk-arb angle.
